oliver-cs: Quick sync for Dynamo reserved bring-up before renewal QBR next week. Need quota plan, priming steps, and a 2h rollback block. Prefer Wed 09:00 PT.
raj-eng: I can pin pool-99 (3x A100) and provide warm IPs. What steady QPS and p95 goal?
oliver-cs: Planning for 95 QPS, ~420 tokens/req. Target p95 < 370ms. Renewal risk if latency breach or cost jump > 10%.
mira-ops: Draft run: 1) reserve pool + seed 7k tokens 2) 15m shadow @10% 3) ramp to 60% for 20m 4) full 50m soak 5) 2h rollback window. I'll put exact commands in /runbooks/dedicated/dynamo-quickstart.md
sasha-sre: Autoscale suggestion: min=2 target_util=0.7 max=10. Enable batch_floor=6 and max_batch_ms=30. Add fallback to q4_0_small if p95 > 800ms for >90s.
ops-bot: autoscale policy applied to pool-99: {min:2,target_util:0.7,max:10} :white_check_mark:
kai-data: I'll prepare a cost vs latency snapshot and a tiny CSV for the QBR; will flag any delta >8%.
raj-eng: Whitelist confirmed for 54.72.16.0/26. Priming run starts in ~15m.
oliver-cs: Good. Capture enablement notes (who joined, docs shared), and send quick 3-question survey after soak. If any anomaly, tag @sasha-sre immediately. :thumbsup:
